scope: Final fixed scope: 23 placed packets a-w plus four incoming ZIPs, 27 proposal collections. The initial a-v stage and its 55-file/129-record inventory remain separately identified. The closing audit covers w and all four new archives through four detailed review notes, including optional and future suggestions. No later moving-main check is part of this audit.

initial_stage.note: These are initial-stage counts, not a census of the final 27 collections.

coverage_limit: The audit is scoped to proposals in the requested locations. It does not claim line-by-line semantic review of every bundled unchanged source snapshot or of every historical manuscript transitively linked by docs/incoming/README.md. Old verification receipts were not rerun and do not validate new candidates.
incoming_state: At the intermediate efa pin, incoming contained only README.md and all 22 packets were placed a-v. At the fixed closing 09d pin, packet w is additionally placed and incoming contains README.md plus four ZIPs: Lean_Proof_Simplification_Post_Adoption_2026-10-26.zip, diophantine-lean-further-deltas-2026-10-26.zip, diophantine-lean-proof-refinements-2026-10-26.zip, and proveit-lean-structural-simplifications-2026-10-26.zip. All four were audited by the review team.
freshness_delta: Packet v forced exclusion of both stateNumber variants. Closing packet w additionally forces withdrawal of the RefinedPair expansion-cancellation proposal and finTwoArrowEquiv cleanup, including their larger-radicand/evaluation follow-ups. The two arithmetic mechanisms and optional explicit quotient-word tile decoder survive the closing audits of all five new collections. Existing helix/periodicity, coordinate equivalences, edge fields and newly supplied row-coherence/causality, finite-wall, syntax-minimum/order, Pell-anchor and color-moment proposals are all prior work.
excluded_mechanisms_scope: The enumerated 129 records below are the initial a-v ledger. Additional closing mechanisms are recorded in the four closing audit notes, with overlap retained rather than summed as independent ideas.
policy: Treat positive, unimplemented, deferred, screened, optional and future-research suggestions alike as already applied; renamed helpers and stronger compiler receipts do not make an old idea new.
